raw:
The design is ten blocks of ten experiments. Each block keeps one edit fixed and varies one or two parent edges in matched pairs, so differences within a pair show whether a condition changes the edit's effect.

| Block | Edit | Parent factors varied |
|---|---|---|
| A | e5→conv3x3 | e3 skip vs none; old e5 op |
| B | e3→skip | e3 old op; conv-heavy vs pool/1x1 cells |
| C | e0→none | whether e2/e4 consume node 1; old e0 op |
| D | e2→conv3x3 | e5 op (none blocks the path); e0 none |
| E | e4→avg_pool | old e4 op × e3 skip/none |
| F | e1→conv3x3 | e5 none vs conv; old e1 op; e3 |
| G | e3→none | old e3 op; whether other paths reach the output |
| H | e0→conv3x3 | e2/e4 present vs none; old e0 op |
| I | e5→skip | e3 op; old e5 op |
| J | e4→conv3x3 | e0 op; old e4 op; e3 |
